shawnee.name: Shawnee County, Kansas
shawnee.cite: Shawnee County Zoning Regulations, Article 39, Section 39.05(a)
shawnee.note: Labels for the required-contents check. They follow Sec. 39.05(a)(1) through (a)(24). They are not a verbatim reprint of the adopted ordinance.

items.text: Name and address of the preparer, with a signature block.
Sheet title centred at the top of the sheet.
Sheet size at least 24 by 36 inches.
North arrow, date, and a vicinity map.
Electronic copy of the plan.
Boundary dimensions, legal description, written scale, and graphic scale.
Existing contours at an interval of 2 feet or less.
Utilities and easements.
Drainage arrows, ponds, and a site summary table.
Structures, with stories, gross floor area, and entrances.
Curb cuts, radii, aisles, parking including accessible stalls, and loading.
Screen walls and fences, with height and material.
Surfacing of drives, parking, and other paved areas.
Streets and right-of-way.
Landscape schedule.
Signage.
Parking stall dimensions.
Site lighting.
Trash enclosure screening.
Plat restrictions.
Floodplain limits and base flood elevation.
On-site sewage disposal, where used.
Open space.
Drainage report.
